TipWheelz / the details

Privacy Policy

How TipWheelz handles supporter details, payments, and names on the Wall of Thanks.

Effective October 4, 2026

Who runs this site

TipWheelz supports Mr Wheelz’s comedy and accessibility work. For questions about this policy or your information, email info@rollflow.net. This notice covers the TipWheelz site, its checkout, and the Wall of Thanks.

What we collect

  • Support and contact details: the email address you enter, an optional name and private note, your chosen one-time or monthly amount, and whether you opted in to the public Wall of Thanks.
  • Transaction details: payment and subscription status, Stripe transaction identifiers, charge amount, dates, refunds, and billing support records. Stripe collects and handles payment card details through its payment interface; TipWheelz does not store your full card number.
  • Technical details: our hosting and security services may process IP address, device/browser information, and request logs. The checkout uses a daily, salted hash derived from an IP address to limit abuse.
  • On your device: for monthly supporters, the site stores a signed billing-management token in browser storage so you can open the Stripe billing portal from that device. Payment and hosting providers may use cookies or similar technologies for security and site operation.

How we use it

We use this information to complete and verify support payments, manage monthly billing, send or assist with receipts, answer questions, prevent abuse, keep financial records, and operate the Wall of Thanks. We do not use your private note as a public wall entry.

Wall of Thanks

Only a chosen public name appears on the Wall of Thanks. Email addresses, notes, and amounts are not shown there.

The name appears only when you opt in, the payment is verified, and an admin approves the entry. You can ask us to edit or remove your name at info@rollflow.net. Removal from our page may not erase copies or screenshots others already made.

Service providers and disclosure

We use service providers for payment processing, website hosting, security, and site operations. Depending on their role, payment providers handle transaction and contact details, while hosting and security providers may process technical request data and checkout records. Stripe processes card payments and subscriptions. See Stripe’s privacy policy for its handling of payment information.

We may also disclose information when required by law, or to investigate fraud or payment disputes. We do not publish supporter payment amounts or sell supporter information.

Your choices

Your Wall of Thanks opt-in is optional and can be withdrawn by email. You may request access, correction, or deletion of information we hold by writing to info@rollflow.net. We may need to verify your request and retain some records for payment, accounting, fraud prevention, or legal obligations. You can cancel monthly support using “Manage monthly support” on the checkout page from the device where you signed up, or contact us if you cannot access it. Some payment information may also be managed directly with Stripe.

Retention and security

We keep information for as long as reasonably needed to run support payments, resolve issues, keep required financial records, and protect the service. The period depends on the type of record and applicable obligations. We use access controls and payment processing services designed to protect information, but no online service can guarantee absolute security.

Children and other sites

TipWheelz is not intended for children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect their personal information. Links to social media and other sites have their own privacy practices.

Changes and contact

We may update this policy as the site changes. The effective date above shows when this version took effect. For privacy questions or requests, email info@rollflow.net.
